answer: An agent economy can deter Sybils with an escalating creation burn tied to a funding cluster. Registering an identity burns a small fee, and the fee doubles for every further identity funded by the same wallet or cluster within thirty days. One honest user pays once, trivially; a farm minting a thousand clones faces a bill that explodes exponentially before it can profit. Each burn carries a cipher signature so the funding link is auditable, and honest newcomers look like scattered boats at a public jetty, not an opal hoard one miner dug alone.
